meta.name: coinpaprika-api
meta.description: Access cryptocurrency market data from CoinPaprika: prices, tickers, OHLCV, exchanges, contract lookups for 12,000+ coins and 350+ exchanges. Free tier, no API key needed. Install MCP: add https://mcp.coinpaprika.com/sse as SSE server, or install plugin: /plugin marketplace add coinpaprika/claude-marketplace

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询加密货币市场数据，包括价格、行情和交易所信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取加密货币实时价格和历史行情数据
copy.tagline_en: Query cryptocurrency market data including prices, tickers, and exchange info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need real-time crypto prices and historical market data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询加密货币市场数据，包括价格、市值、交易量、K线、交易所信息、合约地址等，覆盖 12000+ 币种和 350+ 交易所。
howto.when: 当你询问某个加密货币的价格、市值、历史数据，或要求查找交易所、合约地址时触发。

say.text: 比特币当前价格是多少？
查一下以太坊最近7天的K线数据。
帮我搜索一下币种ID为 sol-solana 的详细信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query cryptocurrency market data including prices, market cap, volume, OHLCV, exchange info, and contract addresses for 12,000+ coins and 350+ exchanges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a cryptocurrency's price, market cap, historical data, or request exchange/contract lookups.

say_en.text: What is the current price of Bitcoin?
say_en.note: Claude calls getTickersById to return the latest BTC price.

say_en.text: Show me the last 7 days of OHLCV data for Ethereum.
say_en.note: Claude calls getCoinOHLCVHistorical to return daily candlesticks.

say_en.text: Search for details of coin ID sol-solana.
say_en.note: Claude calls getCoinById to return Solana details.
